fields.label: Webhook Callback URL
fields.description: Where the gateway should send events. Leave blank to use this site's own URL. Set it when the gateway cannot reach that address — a remote gateway refuses to register a callback pointing at localhost or a private network ("Destination address is not allowed"), so a local site needs a public tunnel here, e.g. https://your-tunnel.example/api/method/frappe_whatsapp_openwa.api.webhook.receive

fields.label: Default Routing Mode
fields.description: Which of an account's OpenWA sessions carries a message, for accounts that have not chosen. Account-level: one session carries everything. Message-level: spread across sessions so no single number carries a campaign. Hybrid: the default session while it can send, spilling to another when it hits its rate or cap. Meta is not a routing option — it is the fallback when no session can send, and that is reported.

fields.options:
Want to be told when a fallback happens?
Every fallback already writes a WhatsApp Fallback Log record. Create a Notification on that doctype with Send Alert On set to New, and choose email, WhatsApp or system notification there. That way the alert honours your own recipients, conditions and channels, and it stops when you disable the Notification.

fields.label: Daily Send Limit
fields.description: Ceiling on OpenWA messages per day across every session. 0 means no ceiling. Each session's own Daily Soft Cap still applies as the per-number guard — whichever limit is reached first stops the send. Counters reset at midnight.

fields.label: Max Sends per Window (all sessions)
fields.description: Ceiling on send rate across every session. 0 means no overall rate ceiling.

fields.label: Max Inbound Media Size (MB)
fields.description: Largest media file the webhook will download from the gateway. Anything bigger is logged and skipped.

fields.label: Webhook Freshness Window (seconds)
fields.description: Reject deliveries whose signed timestamp is older than this — it is what stops a captured request being replayed later. Must stay comfortably above the gateway's own retry and reconcile delays.

fields.label: Max Provision Requests
fields.description: Session provisioning calls allowed per window, per user.

fields.label: Queue Batch Size
fields.description: Outbound queue rows processed per run.

fields.label: Stuck Sending Timeout (minutes)
fields.description: A row left Sending longer than this is treated as a dead worker and re-queued. Keep it well above any request timeout.

fields.label: Outbound Queue Retention (days)
fields.description: Applies to Failed, Expired and Cancelled rows.
